title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Masonic Temple, Detroit | 2023
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Masonic Temple in Detroit, Michigan, USA, on 7 October 2023.

It was the 39th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 43 dates between May and October 2023.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Photograph’
